result_merge_need_two: Pick at least two resource packs (.zip) to merge.
community_key_missing: This needs a free CurseForge API key — you can add it in Settings.
status_paused: ⏸ Paused — progress so far is saved.
confirm_cancel: Cancel the translation? What's already translated stays saved, but the rest won't be done.
hint_ai_provider: "Memory only" doesn't translate anything new: it just builds the file from what's already saved from earlier translations. Anything missing goes to Pending for manual review.
hint_concurrency: How many texts the program asks the AI to translate at the same time, instead of waiting for one to finish before starting the next. Higher = faster, but puts more load on whichever AI provider you picked. 4 worked well in our tests; lower it if something starts failing.
label_content_only: Skip mods with no real content (config/optimization only)
hint_curseforge_key: It's free — request one at console.curseforge.com. Lets the app check whether a community translation already exists for your modpack before spending anything on AI. Leave it empty and that option just won't show up.
error_missing_paths: Fill in the modpack path and the output folder.
